title: Valid login with correct credentials
steps: 1. Navigate to login page 2. Enter valid username 3. Enter valid password 4. Click Login

title: Invalid password shows error
steps: 1. Navigate to login page 2. Enter valid username 3. Enter wrong password 4. Click Login

title: Account lockout after 5 failed attempts
steps: 1. Attempt login with wrong password 5 times
expected_result: Account is locked and lockout message is shown

title: Apply valid coupon code
steps: 1. Add item to cart 2. Go to checkout 3. Enter valid coupon 4. Click Apply
expected_result: Discount is applied and total is updated

title: Apply expired coupon code
steps: 1. Add item to cart 2. Go to checkout 3. Enter expired coupon 4. Click Apply

title: Search returns relevant results
steps: 1. Enter keyword in search bar 2. Press Enter
expected_result: Results relevant to keyword are displayed

title: Search with no results
expected_result: No results found message is shown

title: Update profile picture
steps: 1. Go to profile 2. Upload new picture 3. Save
expected_result: Profile picture is updated and persists after reload

title: Payment fails with declined card
steps: 1. Enter declined test card 2. Submit payment

title: User receives email on order confirmation
expected_result: Confirmation email is received within 2 minutes
